categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Gates the unconditional log line inside CreateNewBlock() behind a debug flag.
categories.rationale: Gating a log line does not affect template validity, accounting, or generation latency. The change solely prevents log bloat when services frequently call block template generation.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label and adds a new logging category to debug logging flags.
categories.rationale: This addresses linked issue #36334 where node operators running Electrum servers experienced excessive debug.log bloat. Adding a debug category to quiet unconditional logging provides clear user value while being reasonably deferrable.
